proof_body:
by
  intro R _ S hS
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 : (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id S.X₃)).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1) = 0 := by
      rw [h, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
    obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ S.X₃ hS _ (zero_add 1) h0
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).2 x₂
    refine ⟨s, (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_bijective _ _).1 ?_⟩
    rw [← hx₂, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀]
  · rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
    have h1 := hS.comp_extClass
    have h2 : (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ s).comp ((CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g).comp hS.extClass (zero_add 1)) (zero_add 1) = 0 := by
      rw [h1, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, hs, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_id_comp] at h2
    exact h2
target_source: ∀ (R : Type) [Ring R] (S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R)) (hS : S.ShortExact), hS.extClass = 0 ↔ ∃ s : S.X₃ ⟶ S.X₂, CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp s S.g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id S.X₃
